com.zynthec.zLoader.name: zLoader
com.zynthec.zLoader.subtitle: Independent SideStore fork for iPhone and iPad.
com.zynthec.zLoader.localizedDescription: Sideloading and manage apps, deveoloper profiles and much more in zynthec style.
com.zynthec.zLoader.versionDescription: My Apps uses four columns with larger icons and fully wrapping app names. Settings and submenus share native grouped surfaces, separators and row sizing while keeping the existing palette and symbols. Selecting the integrated tunnel offers setup when its configuration or signing authorization is missing.
